classification: Retrospective chronological walk-forward, not untouched holdout
selection_cutoff: Each fold uses only prior closed-candle equity and closed trades before the cutoff
daily_comparison: Daily and intraday compare on same last two test segments; never compare two-segment total to six-segment total
risk_comparison: ATR/confirmation choices frozen before test, evaluated as paired controls; their hindsight winners are not retroactively selected
